question_text: Explain how cloud infrastructure can let a service run across several geographical regions instead of one local server.
adaptation_rationale: Retains distributed/cloud reasoning as infrastructure purpose and benefit; does not require web-decentralization political claims.
solution: The provider supplies network-accessible computing/storage resources in multiple locations. A service can deploy or replicate workloads across them, so a single local site need not host all processing and capacity can be added where demand occurs.

marking_points.criterion: Explains reduced single-site dependence or capacity benefit.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Concrete answer reasoned and checked against full syllabus guidance and available source MS.
